ValidationRule.description: To close a case that is classified as "Queries" must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name and Asset.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), SER_Post_liquidation__c = TRUE , SER_Settled__c = FALSE, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Subtype_GM__c )), ISBLANK(SER_Asset__c ), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId ), AND( !ISBLANK(AccountId), Account.Name = "BBVA Internal Contact" ) ) ), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c, "Queries"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case that is classified as "Queries" must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name and Asset. Client Name can't be an Internal Contact Client.
